title: Open My Eyes That I May See
tune: OPEN MY EYES THAT I MAY

sections.name: Verse 1
lines: [Fm/C]Open [Cm]my eyes, that I [Db]may see Glimpses [Cm/G]of truth [Eb/G]Thou hast for me;
[Eb/G]Place in my hands the [Ab]wonderful key That [Bbm]shall unclasp [Db/Ab]and set me free.
[Db/Ab]Silently [Ab]now I wait [Fm]for Thee, Ready, [Bbm/F]my [Eb/Bb]God, Thy will to see;
[Cm/G]Open my eyes, illumine me, Spirit Divine!

sections.name: Verse 2
lines: [Cm/G]Open my ears, illumine me, Spirit Divine!

sections.name: Verse 3
lines: [Cm/G]Open my heart, illumine me, Spirit Divine!
